question.text: Standard Indian AIF market practice caps OPERATING EXPENSES (legal, audit, admin, accounting, etc., excluding management and performance fees) at approximately which range, on which base?

answer.text: 10-50 basis points on NAV or committed capital (whichever is higher), per year
5 bps on daily NAV, with monthly crystallisation

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 6 states operating expenses are recurring, typically 10-50 bps on NAV OR committed capital (whichever is higher), YEARLY. Covers statutory, legal, audit, banking, etc. **The Trap:** B is the SET-UP cost (one-time) — not operating; C invents a GST-proportional cap; D is Cat III daily NAV language (excluded at XIX-D). **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C covers this. XIX-E (Cat III) uses daily NAV mechanisms — not Cat I/II. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** When negotiating, INSIST on 'higher of NAV or committed capital' as the base so that in a down year the expense ratio does not balloon as a percentage of a shrunken NAV. Some GPs push for 'NAV-only' base — push back at the LPA stage.
